note: Supersedes the 0.59/0.83 first baseline. Two changes earned it: table chunks are now fed into the extraction prompt (recovered all 8 tabulated claims, incl. the 733m/10m undernourished pair), and the scorer matches on content-word overlap instead of substring containment (recovered 2 claims that were found but reworded). Remaining misses are all general prose statements; 4 of them were matched in the pre-table run, so extraction of prose claims may have regressed slightly or may just be run-to-run variance — unmeasured, needs a repeat run to tell apart.
